key_provisions_or_claims: Amends ECA art. 241 to penalise developing or selling AI-generated sexual/nude images or videos using a child's or adolescent's face.
Adds §3 to Penal Code art. 218 criminalising AI-generated sexual content using a victim's face without consent.
Justification stresses protection of children, adolescents and women, dignity and gender equality.
Law would take effect on publication.
named_instruments_referenced: Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente (Lei 8.069/1990)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian bill PL 6211/2023 amends the Child and Adolescent Statute and the Penal Code to criminalise creating or selling AI-generated erotic or pornographic images/videos using the face of children, adolescents, or non-consenting victims, justified by protection of dignity, privacy and vulnerable groups.
annotation.title_clean: PL 6211/2023 - Altera a Lei nº 8.069/1990 (ECA) e o Código Penal para criminalizar conteúdo erótico e pornográfico gerado por inteligência artificial a partir do rosto de crianças, adolescentes e vítimas
annotation.title_en: Bill 6211/2023 - Amending the Child and Adolescent Statute and Penal Code to criminalise AI-generated erotic and pornographic content using the faces of children, adolescents and victims
